caption: The drawing depicts an old-style clock face set on a rectangular, light tan or beige background that resembles wood grain. The clock face itself is primarily white, bordered by a thin black outline, and has an arched top. The clock features large black Roman numerals marking the hours from I to XII and smaller black numbers marking the minutes in increments of 15 along the outer edge. There are two smaller sub-dials within the main face, one at the top and another at the bottom, each marked with numbers. The four corners of the rectangular part of the clock face have small floral designs with green stems and blue and red flowers. In the arched top section, there is a framed, colored illustration showing a small house or building with a red roof, surrounded by green trees and grass, and a clear blue sky. The artist's name, "ANN GENE BUCKLEY," is written in all capital letters in black at the bottom center of the image below the clock face.
title: Clock Face
